title: IPO News - US IPO Weekly Recap: Bending Spoons shines in IPO, while Cumberland Farms and Jersey Mike’s join the pipeline
content:
Four SPACs submit initial filings this week. B&R Technology Merger (BRTMU), led by venture capitalist David York, filed to raise $325 million to target AI-related tech. Laris Growth Acquisition (LARSU) filed to raise $200 million to target quantum computing and autonomous systems. Three Lions Acquisition (TLACU) filed to raise $100 million to target sports, hospitality, and real estate. Gold Mountain Acquisition (GDMTU) filed to raise $75 million to target businesses in Asia. [...] Four SPACs also priced this week. Ares Acquisition III (AAC.U), the third blank check company formed by Are Management, raised $345 million. Osprey Acquisition III (OSPRU) raised $261 million to target energy infrastructure. Viking Acquisition II (VII.U), the second SPAC led by executives from KingsRock, raised $200 million.
